Name: They Thrive
Author: emurphy42
Description:
You always did suspect that Joja was more than just a typical greedy corporation...

Recolors JojaMart and Morris if you're wearing sunglasses.
[list]
[*]By default, recognizes either [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Sunglasses]the Sunglasses hat[/url]﻿ or accessory #17. You can edit the config.json file to change this (use commas to separate multiple values).
[*]Changing hats will update recoloring next time the clock changes. (It takes a few minutes for your eyes to adjust.)
[*]Recolor is permanently deactivated after the Community Center ceremony, or if you buy a Joja membership (they buy a more powerful transmitter).
[/list]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/emurphy42/TheyThrive]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
